assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a completely NEW Kalistar portrait illustration of Vivi from Final Fantasy IX in an entirely different scene, camera and pose. Image 1 is character design only: tiny black mage, black featureless face with two warm yellow eyes, oversized soft tan pointed hat, weathered blue coat, beige striped trousers, brown gloves and boots. Image 2 is PAINT TEXTURE AND ART DIRECTION ONLY, never copy its robot anatomy. Scene: an abandoned stone footbridge in a quiet snowy mountain pass at early morning. Vivi is STANDING and taking a careful step, seen from a low three-quarter angle, both gloved hands holding a straight wooden staff diagonally planted on the frosted paving. A controlled ribbon of luminous pale-blue ice spreads from the staff tip into a low protective ice ridge across the foreground. His lifted face and eyes convey fragile courage. Full figure large and central, staff handle straight. Coat tails move gently. Background restrained: one weathered arch and pale mountain silhouettes, soft empty sky, no crowd or detailed city. Traditional Kalistar narrative painting, bold visible brush marks and layered color planes, patinated fabric and rock, emotionally intimate, not photoreal or smooth 3D. Portrait 4:5 framing safe for card crop. NO sitting under tree, NO little glowing object in an open palm, NO copy of original composition, NO text, border, logo or statistics. Keep two arms/two legs, yellow eyes, no mouth.

Use case: illustration-story. Paint a completely new Kalistar illustration of Vivi from Final Fantasy IX. Reference 1 is his exact costume/identity, not its scene: small black mage, two luminous yellow oval eyes in absolute black face, soft oversized tan hat, patched blue coat, striped trousers, brown gloves and boots. Reference 2 is ONLY the coarse painterly Kalistar material/luminous color-plane style, not robot anatomy. Completely new scene and camera: on the wooden deck of a grounded old airship at dusk, Vivi leans forward with one knee braced on a low wooden crate and one boot on deck, viewed slightly from above in three-quarter front view. His right hand grips a straight staff held vertically beside his body. His left gloved hand is carefully held near a small unlit brass deck lantern on the crate; a few controlled blue-gold electric filaments bridge his fingertips to the lantern and make it light. A brave practical little act, wonder and concentration conveyed by his head tilt. The character occupies most of the portrait, readable hands and full head. Quiet background: one broad timber beam, a short stretch of rope railing and open violet dusk sky, no busy machinery or city panorama. Strong varied composition with natural anatomy, restrained magic. Coarse painted grain and brushwork, scuffed fabric, warm lantern against blue sparks, no smooth CGI, no anime. Portrait 4:5. No seated tree scene, no flames in open palm, no card frame, no words.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated Kalistar race portrait icon, MICE: a noble mouse-human knight, HEAD AND UPPER SHOULDERS, facing three-quarter RIGHT, with very large round mouse ears, short delicate cream-furred muzzle, small rose nose and bright dark eyes. Natural living face, ivory and warm grey fur, not entirely made of silver. Wears a restrained green-copper gorget and a small weathered silver brow plate leaving the rounded ears free. Image1 reference for living face plus armor portrait and painted materials. Image2 reference for Kalistar emblem polish only; do NOT use deer anatomy. Compact elegant silhouette filling a circular icon space, finely painted readable large shapes. This is a generic race representative, not Freyja. No long mane, no wolf muzzle, no jagged beard, no round medallion border, no background, no text, no weapon. Actual transparent alpha all around, entire head and ears intact.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated Kalistar BATRA race icon: FRONT-FACING broad amphibian-human head with upper shoulders, intelligent widely spaced golden eyes, a broad horizontal mouth, soft sage-green and teal mottled skin, cream throat. Distinct amphibian proportions, gentle imposing presence. A low weathered bronze shoulder collar with simple dark teal cloth, no crown or horns. Reference1 for living colored skin combined with small Kalistar metal armor accents, not reptile anatomy or fins. Reference2 for painted bust-icon finish. Make a unique rounded broad silhouette, nearly symmetrical but with slight head tilt, not a sideways wolf head. Painterly premium miniature icon, tactile organic skin and patinated bronze, large readable forms. No hair mane, no engraved silver face, no dragon, no long neck, no medallion rim, no backdrop or text. Centered with actual transparent alpha and generous small margin; entire silhouette visible.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single Kalistar RATZ race icon, head and neck only in sharp LEFT PROFILE. A wary rat-human face with long slender pointed rat muzzle, small rounded ears, dark grey-brown natural short fur, pale worn incisor, pink-brown nose, alert dark amber eye. A dark burgundy leather hood is pulled behind the ears, with a narrow tarnished copper fastening under the chin. No luxuriant wolf mane. Use first reference for the strong narrow side-profile silhouette and restrained copper detail, NOT bird or metal feather anatomy. Second reference for a living face with painted armor/material detail. Natural fur and leather should dominate, not an all-silver sculpture. Compact clear rat identity, dramatically different from the round Mice portrait. Entire head and hood visible on genuine transparent alpha. No body, no medallion rim, no text, no scenery, no floating fine whiskers.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated Kalistar MACAKO race emblem: a living macaque-human adventurer shown from CHEST UP in three-quarter FRONT view looking slightly upward. Warm russet short fur, lighter tan face, broad expressive brows, short primate muzzle, small round ears, intelligent curious brown eyes. A worn blue scarf and simple copper-edged leather shoulder straps. Reference1 and2 for the existing Kalistar race icons' painterly living anatomy, cloth, armor and believable warm colors. Do not make a silver animal-head ornament or gorilla. Round compact silhouette with shoulders, engaging expression, large readable face, neatly structured fur without long mane. Premium painted fantasy portrait, not cartoon or photograph. No weapon, no full scenery, no circle around it, no crown, no lettering. Genuine transparent background; all silhouette edges visible.
